description:
About NCR VOYIX 
 
 NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.
 
 
 
 
 
 We are looking for talented engineers to join our Tools Platform Engineering Team.
 
 Our primary customers are engineers inside of NCR Voyix using on-prem and cloud-hosted tools that improve productivity for NCR Voyix’s development community. We experience the impact our work is having, and we take pride in providing services with great availability and ease of use.
 
 How do you know if you're right for this job?
 You thrive in a fast-paced environment focused on improving and supporting production environments at a regular cadence using Agile techniques.
 You apply an AI-first approach to software engineering, evaluating AI-powered tools, agentic workflows, and automation opportunities as the preferred starting point for solving software development challenges, from small feature enhancements to complex enterprise-scale solutions.
 You can analyze and review existing platforms and processes and provide meaningful feedback on improvement and convert this to actionable tasks and projects.
 You practice continuous learning to keep up with current trends and design patterns in the software world.
 You have a deep understanding and passion for the cloud and supporting tools development
 You understand the value that tools and automation bring to an engineering team's ability to effectively develop and reliably operate high-scale systems.
 You thrive on the success of your team by supporting them from a technical and architectural aspect, by guiding and mentoring others on the team.
 You can tackle problems both at the large scale and small scale.
 
 Experience you need:
 4+ years of software development experience with a focus on designing and deploying API-led, microservice architected solutions.
 Skilled in cloud technologies, like GCP and Azure with 3 years of experience deploying to production environments.
 Proven experience in developing AI Agentic solutions to solve practical, day-to-day engineering problems.
 4+ years in .NET development (C#)
 2+ years of Python scripting experience.
 YAML CI/CD workflow development (ideally Github Actions)
 AI Agent development and skills creation (YAML, Markdown)
 Experience with Containerized applications in a production environment (Kubernetes, Docker, Helm)
 Demonstrated ability to mentor other software engineers.
 Good understanding of computer science fundamentals.
 BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
 
 Experience we hope to see:
 At least 2 years experience with Typescript, Javascript, Go.
 Experience of MCP server development and management.
 Experience of Atlassian tool stack.
 Experience of observability tooling like Splunk, AppDynamics
 Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job
 
 EEO Statement 
 Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law.  NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential.  We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people.  Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.
 
 Statement to Third Party Agencies 
To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes
 
 “When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”
